core.name: Bamum
core.notes: Full modern syllabary (Phase G / Mfemfe). All 80 base characters mapped with phonetic values and Unicode codepoints.

core.name: Cherokee
core.notes: Complete 85-character syllabary. Full vowel×consonant grid with IPA transcriptions.

core.name: Japanese Kana
core.native: ひらがな · カタカナ
core.notes: 46 Hiragana + 46 Katakana. Toggle between scripts. Paired character display.

core.name: Yi (Nuosu)
core.notes: Starter set: 80 of 1,165 characters. Covers vowels + common consonant families across all 4 tones. Full set requires phased expansion.

core.name: Vai
core.notes: Core set: ~70 of ~300 characters. Covers vowels + 10 consonant series. ~55 high-frequency chars handle 80-90% of daily writing.

core.name: Canadian Aboriginal
core.notes: Cree syllabics: 12 consonant series × 4 vowel rotations + finals. Rotation principle fully demonstrated.

core.name: Mende Kikakui
core.notes: Core set: 70 of 195 characters. 9 consonant series + vowels, each with 7 vowel variants. Right-to-left script.

core.name: Linear B
core.notes: Core Ventris-Chadwick grid: 59 confirmed syllabic signs across 13 consonant series × 5 vowels. Deciphered 1952.

core.name: Chinese Hanzi
core.notes: Target: 3,500 most common characters. Radicals-first teaching approach. Enormous scope — needs phased rollout.

core.name: Japanese Kanji
core.notes: Target: 2,136 jōyō kanji. On/kun readings. Can share radical system with Hanzi module.

core.name: Egyptian Hieroglyphs
core.notes: Target: ~1,000 common signs. Mix of logographic, alphabetic, and determinative. Gardiner classification system.

core.name: Cuneiform
core.notes: Target: ~600 common signs. Sumerian and Akkadian values. Clay tablet aesthetic.

core.name: Maya Glyphs
core.notes: Partially in Unicode. Complex glyph-block system. Research needed on available digital character sets.

core.name: Naxi Dongba
core.notes: NOT YET IN UNICODE. Only living pictographic script. ~1,400 pictograms. Will need custom font or image-based approach.

core.name: Ge'ez (Ethiopic)
core.notes: 33 consonants × 7 vowel forms = 231 syllables. Highly systematic. Good Unicode support.

core.name: Tibetan
core.notes: 30 consonants + stacking system. Vertical consonant clusters. Needs careful handling of conjuncts.

core.name: Devanagari
core.notes: 47 primary characters. Shirorekha headline. Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi, Nepali.

core.name: Korean Hangul
core.notes: 24 letters. Featural alphabet — shapes encode articulatory features. Syllable block assembly system.

core.name: Sundanese
core.notes: 32 base characters. Brahmi-derived. Currently being revitalized in schools.

core.name: Georgian
core.notes: 33 consonants. UNESCO Intangible Heritage. Completely unique lineage — no known ancestor.

core.name: N'Ko
core.notes: 27 letters, right-to-left. Created 1949 by Solomana Kanté. Growing digital adoption.

core.name: Phoenician
core.notes: 22 letters. Ancestor of Greek, Latin, Arabic, Hebrew. The original abjad. Small character set — quick build.

core.name: Linear A
core.notes: UNDECIPHERED. ~77 signs known. Special "mystery mode" — learn the signs, attempt your own decipherment.

core.name: Elder Futhark
core.notes: 24 runes. Each has name + symbolic meaning beyond sound value. Small set — quick build. Rune meanings layer.
